faq.a: Hilmi is associated with the Arabic form حِلْمِي, whose core sense is hilmi; of forbearance (relative form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Hilmi?
faq.a: Hilmi is associated with Arabic. Hilmi is the Turkish form of Arabic حِلْمِيّ (Ḥilmī), the relative form of حِلْم (forbearance), used as a male given name.
Yes — the underlying form حِلْمِي is Arabic.
Hilmi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hilmi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥilmī is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Hilmi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hilmi is rendered حلمی and carries the sense حلمی، بردباری سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Hilmi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hilmi is rendered حلمی and carries the sense حلمی، منسوب به حلم.
A romanized syllable approximation is hil-mi. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hilmi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hilmi, hilmi. Script forms are حلمي, حلمی, حِلْمِي, हिल्मी.

faq.q: Is Hilmi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
